description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseMessage' used for API requests within the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi' namespace. It provides a unique correlation identifier used for logging purposes.

classes.name: BaseMessage
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for API request message classes, providing a unique correlation ID.

methods.name: CorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the unique correlation identifier associated with this message.
